Name: TP's Arknights_Logos Portrait
Author: Tampey
Description:
This portrait is based on a portrait of [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Aquaasa]Aquaasa[/url]'s [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30904]Arknights-Logos mod[/url].


[u]These download files don't have a manifast.json file. You have to find and add the path file yourself.[/u]


How to install

[list]
[*]If you don't already have them, download the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url]﻿ mod 
[*]Download this mod.
[*]Mods/Portraiture/Portraits and create a new folder.
[*]Put the portraits from this mod into the new folder.
[*]

[/list]After that, I'm thinking of making it for the season and the beach. The only file have a default.
